House Price Prediction

Making housing data useful.

Pythonpandasscikit-learnXGBoostStreamlit
Explore the repository ↗
Problem

Why this project?

Housing prices depend on multiple property characteristics. This project uses Ames Housing data to explore regression and presents a prediction interface for entering property features.

Approach

From input to output.

The project combines a training notebook, dataset files, a serialized model, and a Streamlit application. The repository describes Random Forest and XGBoost experimentation, feature engineering, cross-validation, and hyperparameter tuning.

Implementation
01

Training workspace

A dedicated notebook separates model development from the prediction interface.

02

Six input features

The application uses total square footage, lot area, year built, bedrooms above ground, total bathrooms, and garage capacity.

03

Interactive prediction

A Streamlit interface connects property inputs to a saved model, with deployment instructions in the repository.

What to keep in mind

Predictions reflect the Ames Housing dataset and the trained model. They are illustrative estimates, not current market valuations. No accuracy figure is presented here without a verified evaluation result.
